approval_rationale: The changed root files satisfy TASK-001's guardrail scope without introducing a blocking defect. .env.example keeps OPENROUTER_API_KEY as a non-secret placeholder while preserving the required default OPENROUTER_MODEL. .gitignore now covers SQLite sidecar files such as backend/gpt-copy-v8.sqlite-wal, frontend local env overrides, and root build output under target/. README.md provides concrete setup and run guidance while marking backend/frontend/test instructions as provisional, so the documentation does not overstate completion of later implementation tasks.
risks_considered: A placeholder value in .env.example could be mistaken for a usable credential, but the README explicitly instructs users to copy to .env and replace OPENROUTER_API_KEY with a real local key, and no real-looking OpenRouter token was present in the reviewed scope.

The new README includes commands for backend, frontend, and tests before those later tasks are complete, but each affected section is marked provisional and the top status calls out implementation in progress.
Ignore patterns can be easy to under-scope, so git check-ignore was used against representative .env, frontend/.env.local, SQLite database, SQLite WAL, and target/debug paths.
